description:
Find the laws, regulations, standards, frameworks and guidance that TCLP content refers to.

    This is not a general legal database: it holds only the instruments that TCLP
    clauses, guides and glossary terms cite.

    Status "stub": identity confirmed, metadata minimal; a null or empty field means
    not yet recorded, not that it does not apply.
    On a stub, `nature` may be an unreviewed inference, and is often null. Do not
    fill in missing fields from your own knowledge, and do not state an
    instrument's legal effect.

    A filter on nature, sector or bindingness excludes works where that field is
    not recorded. Most works do not record these yet, so an empty result does not
    mean that TCLP content cites no such instrument; prefer `query` or
    `jurisdiction`.

    Args:
        query: Case-insensitive substring match on name and aliases (e.g. "CSRD"),
            at most 200 characters. An exact name or alias match ranks first.
        nature: Any of "legislation", "regulation", "standard", "framework", "guidance".
        jurisdiction: Jurisdiction slugs, matched exactly: lower-case letters,
            digits and hyphens (e.g. "european-union"). Get valid values from
            `taxonomy_facets(scope="legal_resource")`.
        sector: Sector slugs, matched exactly: lower-case letters, digits and
            hyphens. Get valid values from `taxonomy_facets(scope="legal_resource")`.
        bindingness: Any of "binding", "comply_or_explain", "voluntary", "depends".
            Each list filter takes at most 20 values.
        limit: Maximum results (1–100, default 20).
        offset: Result offset for paging (0–10000, default 0).

    Returns:
        JSON with "meta" (total_available, limit, offset) and "results" (one entry
        per instrument, with `work_id` for `get_legal_resource` and `citing_count`).
name: find_legal_resources
